rca of the issue.reported_symptom: 'I don't see the circle buttons for the unified report and family violence report'
rca of the issue.root_cause: User was viewing https://sacoparentsalign.com (custom domain) which is still parked on Squarespace serving a 'Coming Soon' page (HTTP 301 apex -> www; www returns 200 with <title>Coming Soon</title>, server header: Squarespace). The live React app is deployed at https://align-report.emergent.host where the circles render correctly.
rca of the issue.reproduction_of_working_state: 1) Open https://align-report.emergent.host/auth 2) Register a fresh parent account 3) Land on /dashboard -> circle-uniform + circle-safety + 8 bubbles visible 4) Navigate to /hub -> same. All click routes verified (see verification_evidence).
rca of the issue.reproduction_of_broken_state: 1) Open https://sacoparentsalign.com -> 301 to www 2) www.sacoparentsalign.com returns a Squarespace 'Coming Soon' page — the React app never loads, hence no circles.
rca of the issue.mitigation: Point sacoparentsalign.com DNS/hosting to the Emergent deployment (or use the emergent.host domain). No frontend code change required.
